configurations.// note: Same server, bound to every interface so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can reach it for on-device testing. 0.0.0.0 covers loopback too, so the browser preview still works. Remember the camera needs a secure context: over a LAN IP you must add that exact origin to chrome://flags 'Insecure origins treated as secure' on the phone, or the scanner will never open.
